content.text: Two wakings at 19 months is really common. Tonight, try a short, boring check-in when he wakes. Keep the lights off, say one calm line like "night night, I'm here," and leave before he's fully worked up. Skip the new snuggles, feeds or songs, because those can turn into the thing he needs to fall back asleep. The goal is that he learns to settle on his own. A few nights of doing it the same way every time is usually when you start to see a change.
